objects.description: Someone or something that acts — a person, or an agent standing in for one. The persona is the document beside it; only the few fields here mean the same in every domain.

fields.name: id
fields.description: Storage key, opaque to callers and minted by the store.

fields.name: code
fields.description: Internal sequential identifier, "AC-<n>", minted once at creation and never rewritten. Never shown to a member or accepted from one; public_code is.

fields.name: public_code
fields.description: The member code shown and typed: "M-" and random groups of three characters with no look-alikes, such as "M-K7P-4QX-M2T". Drawn once at creation, or by the backfill for a row older than the column, and never rewritten. Unique within the agency.

fields.name: display_name
fields.description: What to call this actor on screen. The only name the domain promises to show.

fields.name: first_name
fields.description: The actor's given name, as they gave it. Empty until they give one. Not what a screen shows by default: display_name is.

fields.name: last_name
fields.description: The actor's family name, as they gave it. Empty until they give one. Not what a screen shows by default: display_name is.

fields.name: is_agentic
fields.description: True when the actor is an agent rather than a person, so a caller can tell a human seat from a machine one.

fields.name: attributes
fields.description: The persona: everything a domain knows about this actor beyond its name. Queried in place by path, so a domain's own vocabulary never becomes a column here.

fields.name: forms_week_split
fields.description: The actor's own choice to see their waiting forms split by closing week, those closing this week apart from those closing later. On for every actor until they turn it off, a row older than the column too, and only the actor themselves changes it.

fields.name: created_at
fields.description: When the row was created.

fields.name: last_updated
fields.description: When the row was last written.

fields.name: deleted
fields.description: Soft delete. A deleted row is invisible to every listing.

indexes.name: attributes_phone
indexes.description: One actor per phone number. The database half of the duplicate-attribute refusal, so a write that races past the Go pre-check still fails.

indexes.name: attributes_email
indexes.description: One actor per email address, for the same reason the phone index exists.

indexes.name: public_code
indexes.description: One member per public code, which is also the lookup an invite or a find by code makes. Rows not yet backfilled carry no code and are left out.

objects.description: A node in the org structure — a department, a cohort, a team. Its parent decides where it sits and its level decides what it is called.

fields.name: id
fields.description: Storage key, opaque to callers and minted by the store.

fields.name: code
fields.description: Internal sequential identifier, "G-<n>", minted once at creation and never rewritten by an edit. Never shown to a member or accepted from one; public_code is.

fields.name: public_code
fields.description: The group code shown and typed: "G-" and random groups of three characters with no look-alikes, such as "G-K7P-4QX-M2T". Drawn once at creation, or by the backfill for a row older than the column, and never rewritten. Unique within the agency.

fields.name: hierarchy_id
fields.description: The level tree this group belongs to. Fixed at creation — a group does not move between hierarchies.

fields.name: level_id
fields.description: The level this group sits at, which is what gives it its depth and its domain noun.

fields.name: parent_id
fields.description: The group directly above this one. Empty at the root, and never a group inside this one's own subtree.

fields.name: name
fields.description: The group's human-readable name, shown wherever the structure is drawn.

fields.name: discoverable
fields.description: True when an actor who is not already registered may find this group and ask to join.

fields.name: join_mode
fields.description: How an actor joins: open writes the registration at once, confirmed holds a join request until the group's deciders approve it. A new group starts confirmed.

fields.name: hidden
fields.description: True when the group is reached only by invitation: it is never listed as joinable and a join or a join request to it answers as a missing group.

fields.name: anchor_level_override_id
fields.description: The level that anchors this group's subtree, where it differs from the hierarchy's default anchor. Empty means the default applies.

fields.name: node_type
fields.description: The group type this group was created as, carried as a plain label rather than a reference.

fields.name: attributes
fields.description: Whatever the domain declares about a group beyond its name, queried in place by path.

fields.name: created_at
fields.description: When the row was created.

fields.name: last_updated
fields.description: When the row was last written.

fields.name: deleted
fields.description: Soft delete. A deleted row is invisible to every listing.

indexes.name: parent
indexes.description: Walks the structure one level down, which is what listing a group's children is.

indexes.name: hierarchy
indexes.description: Reads one hierarchy's whole structure without touching another's.

indexes.name: public_code
indexes.description: One group per public code, which is also the lookup an invite or a find by code makes. Rows not yet backfilled carry no code and are left out.

objects.description: One actor's registration in one group. The pair is the key, so an actor is registered in a group once or not at all.

fields.name: actor_id
fields.description: The registered actor. Half of the key.

fields.name: group_id
fields.description: The group registered in. The other half of the key.

fields.name: attributes
fields.description: Whatever the domain declares about a registration — when it started, what it is for — queried in place by path.

fields.name: created_at
fields.description: When the registration was made. The only date a registration carries.

fields.name: priority
fields.description: How high the registered actor ranks this group among their own. Every registration starts at normal, a newly joined one too, and only the actor themselves changes it.

fields.name: last_updated
fields.description: When the row was last written.

fields.name: deleted
fields.description: Soft delete. A deleted row is invisible to every listing.

indexes.name: group
indexes.description: Lists a group's roster, which is the read the structure screen makes per node.

objects.description: A kind of seat that can be held — chair, treasurer, delegate. Retiring one stops it being granted without disturbing the seats already held.

fields.name: id
fields.description: Storage key, opaque to callers and minted by the store.

fields.name: code
fields.description: Stable human-readable identifier, "RK-<n>", minted once at creation and never rewritten.

fields.name: name
fields.description: What the seat is called, in the domain's own words.

fields.name: capabilities
fields.description: The capability names this kind confers, as a JSON array. Never null on the way out — a kind created without any reads back as an empty list.

fields.name: description
fields.description: What the seat is for, shown wherever a holder is chosen.

fields.name: is_delegate
fields.description: True when the seat stands in for another group rather than governing its own.

fields.name: leads_group
fields.description: True when a seat of this kind makes its holder one of the group's leaders, who decide its join requests and invite to it. Set by the agency; off by default.

fields.name: level_id
fields.description: The level this kind may be granted at. Empty means any level.

fields.name: retired_at
fields.description: When the kind was retired. Empty means it is still grantable — this field is what Retired() reads.

fields.name: retired_by
fields.description: The actor who retired the kind. A domain fact, not audit dressing, which is why retiring takes an actor and unretiring does not.

indexes.name: level
indexes.description: Finds the kinds grantable at one level, which is what a grant form offers.

objects.description: One held seat: an actor holding a role kind in a group. Granted, then ended — revoked, resigned, evicted or departed — and never deleted, so the history of who held what survives.

fields.name: id
fields.description: Storage key. A seat is granted, revoked and stepped down from by id, unlike a registration, which is keyed by its pair.

fields.name: actor_id
fields.description: The actor holding the seat.

fields.name: group_id
fields.description: The group the seat is held in.

fields.name: kind_id
fields.description: The kind of seat held.

fields.name: active
fields.description: True while the seat is held. An ended seat stays as a row with this false.

fields.name: granted_at
fields.description: When the seat was granted.

fields.name: granted_by
fields.description: The actor who granted it.

fields.name: ended_at
fields.description: When the seat stopped being held. Empty while it is still active.

fields.name: ended_reason
fields.description: Why the seat ended: taken away, given up, lost with the group seat, or lost with the registration.

indexes.name: actor
indexes.description: Lists every seat one actor holds, across groups.

indexes.name: group
indexes.description: Lists every seat held in one group, which is what the dashboard reads.

indexes.name: kind
indexes.description: Finds the live seats of one kind, which is what refuses the retirement of a kind still held.

objects.description: One named tree of levels. A domain may keep several — a governance tree and a delivery tree — and a group belongs to exactly one.

fields.name: id
fields.description: Storage key, opaque to callers and minted by the store.

fields.name: code
fields.description: Stable human-readable identifier, "H-<n>", minted once at creation and never rewritten by a rename.

fields.name: name
fields.description: What the tree is called.

objects.description: One rung of a hierarchy: how deep it sits, and whether it is the rung a subtree anchors on.

fields.name: id
fields.description: Storage key, opaque to callers and minted by the store.

fields.name: code
fields.description: Stable human-readable identifier, "L-<n>", minted once at creation and never rewritten by a rename.

fields.name: hierarchy_id
fields.description: The tree this rung belongs to.

fields.name: name
fields.description: What this rung is called, which is the noun a group at it is shown under.

fields.name: depth
fields.description: How far down the tree this rung sits, counting from zero at the root.

fields.name: is_default_anchor
fields.description: True on the one rung per hierarchy that a subtree anchors on unless a group overrides it.

indexes.name: hierarchy
indexes.description: Reads one tree's rungs in order, which is every read of a hierarchy.

objects.description: The domain's own noun for the groups at one level — "chapter", "faculty", "squad" — in both its singular and plural spellings.

fields.name: id
fields.description: Storage key, opaque to callers and minted by the store.

fields.name: code
fields.description: Stable human-readable identifier, "GT-<n>", minted once at creation and never rewritten.

fields.name: hierarchy_id
fields.description: The tree this noun belongs to.

fields.name: name
fields.description: The type's own name, which is what a group carries as its node type.

fields.name: singular
fields.description: How to name one group of this type.

fields.name: plural
fields.description: How to name several.

fields.name: level_id
fields.description: The level this noun applies at. Empty means it applies anywhere in the tree.

indexes.name: hierarchy
indexes.description: Lists one tree's nouns, which is what a structure screen reads to label its nodes.

indexes.name: level
indexes.description: Finds the noun for one level, which is the lookup a group's label makes.

objects.description: One actor's request to join one confirmed group. There is at most one per pair: asking again after a decline updates it and marks it an appeal rather than adding another.

fields.name: id
fields.description: Storage key, opaque to callers and minted by the store. A request is decided by id.

fields.name: group_id
fields.description: The group the actor asked to join.

fields.name: actor_id
fields.description: The actor who asked.

fields.name: state
fields.description: Where the request stands: pending until someone decides it, then approved or declined. Asking again returns it to pending.

fields.name: appeal
fields.description: True once the actor has asked again after being declined. It stays true while that appeal is pending and through its decision.

fields.name: message
fields.description: What the actor wrote when asking, at most 500 characters. Asking again replaces it.

fields.name: silent
fields.description: True when a decline was made quietly, so the host raises nothing that tells the actor. Meaningless on any other state.

fields.name: requested_at
fields.description: When the actor asked. An appeal keeps the first ask's time; asking again after an approval starts a fresh one.

fields.name: asked_at
fields.description: When the actor last asked: the first ask, or the latest time they asked again. A decision leaves it alone, so it is the time the actor last saw on a request still pending.

fields.name: decided_by
fields.description: The actor who approved or declined the request. Empty while it is pending, and empty on an approval the group's open policy made by itself.

fields.name: decided_at
fields.description: When the request was approved or declined. Empty while it is pending.

fields.name: decline_reason
fields.description: Why a leader declined the request, at most 500 characters, for the actor to read. Optional, never set on a quiet decline, and cleared when the actor asks again.

fields.name: last_updated
fields.description: When the row was last written.

indexes.name: pair
indexes.description: One request per actor and group, which is what makes asking again an update rather than a second request.

indexes.name: group_state
indexes.description: Lists one group's pending requests, which is the read its deciders make.

indexes.name: actor
indexes.description: Lists one actor's requests, which is how the joinable list knows which groups it has already asked.

objects.description: One approval or decline made on a join request, kept as its own record. A request decided, appealed and decided again holds one record per decision, and none is ever rewritten.

fields.name: id
fields.description: Storage key, opaque to callers and minted by the store. The applicant reads a told decision by id.

fields.name: request_id
fields.description: The join request this decision was made on.

fields.name: group_id
fields.description: The group the request was made to.

fields.name: actor_id
fields.description: The actor who asked, and the only one who may read a told decision.

fields.name: state
fields.description: What was decided.

fields.name: silent
fields.description: True when the decision was made quietly. A quiet decision is never shown to the actor, who reads it as missing.

fields.name: decided_by
fields.description: The actor who made the decision.

fields.name: decided_at
fields.description: When the decision was made.

fields.name: reason
fields.description: Why a leader declined, at most 500 characters, as written at the time. Empty on an approval and on a quiet decline.

indexes.name: request
indexes.description: Lists one request's decisions in order.

indexes.name: actor
indexes.description: Finds one actor's decisions, the read the applicant makes.

objects.description: One invitation from a group's leaders to one actor to join that group, which is how a hidden group is reached. There is at most one per pair: inviting again updates it rather than adding another. Accepting registers the actor; declining or letting it lapse registers nothing.

fields.name: id
fields.description: Storage key, opaque to callers and minted by the store. An invitation is answered by id.

fields.name: group_id
fields.description: The group the actor is invited to.

fields.name: actor_id
fields.description: The actor invited. Only this actor may accept or decline.

fields.name: state
fields.description: Where the invitation stands: pending until the actor answers, then accepted or declined. Inviting again returns it to pending. A lapsed invitation stays pending and is never written to by lapsing.

fields.name: invited_by
fields.description: The actor who issued the invitation, taken from the caller. Inviting again replaces it.

fields.name: invited_at
fields.description: When the invitation was issued. Inviting again replaces it.

fields.name: expires_at
fields.description: When the invitation lapses: the issuer's date, or the issue time plus the host's invitation lifetime when the issuer names none. Empty only on a row issued before that default, which never lapses. A lapsed invitation cannot be accepted and is invited again rather than revived.

fields.name: answered_at
fields.description: When the actor accepted or declined. Empty while it is pending.

fields.name: last_updated
fields.description: When the row was last written.

indexes.name: pair
indexes.description: One invitation per actor and group, which is what makes inviting again an update rather than a second invitation.

indexes.name: group_state
indexes.description: Lists one group's invitations by state, which is the read its leaders make.

indexes.name: actor
indexes.description: Lists one actor's invitations, which is the read the invited actor makes.

objects.description: One counter per coded type, holding the next number its code will take. Written by a compare-and-set so two concurrent creates cannot mint the same code.

fields.name: entity_type
fields.description: The type being counted — actor, group, hierarchy, level, role_kind, grouptype. One row each.

fields.name: next_number
fields.description: The number the next code of this type takes. Read and advanced in one conditional write.

objects.description: How this agency's public member and group codes are drawn. At most one row; with none, codes take three groups.

fields.name: id
fields.description: Always "codes": the agency holds one format.

fields.name: group_count
fields.description: How many groups of three characters a newly drawn code has before any collision adds one. Read each time a code is drawn, so a change applies only to codes drawn afterwards.

fields.name: last_updated
fields.description: When the format last changed.
